key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week as rate-rise fears and oil price surge pressured miners and banks
AUD smashed on growth scare; iron ore entering 'bloodletting' phase
Oil prices exploded after Saudi pipeline closure (Iraq drone attack) and failed price suppression
RBA flagged rental inflation as key concern; housing market showing no spring bounce
ANZ announced 3,500 job cuts; banks under pressure from rising bond yields
Australian fuel prices set to rise ~30c/litre, squeezing consumer and agribusiness margins
High-end property hit by steepest falls while affordable segment remains resilient
Mining cap-raise activity surging (Canaccord-led) signalling sector stress

sectors.trend: Sharp negative. Iron ore in 'bloodletting' phase; Rio Tinto exiting NT operations; mining cap-raises surging as firms scramble for cash. Gold underperforming ('gold schmould'). Small-caps (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka) showing relative strength.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from falling iron ore. Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) lack safe-haven bid. Small-cap explorers (SUN.AX, MNR.AX) may attract speculative flows. Cap-raise dilution risk elevated.

sectors.trend: Negative. Rising bond yields and rate-rise fears compressing valuations. ANZ cutting 3,500 jobs signals cost discipline but weakens growth narrative. Superannuation policy debate (One Nation, early access) creating political overhang.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX under pressure from yield curve steepening. ANZ.AX restructuring may support near-term margins but caps upside. Super policy uncertainty (headlines 26,35,52,80) a medium-term risk to fund flows.

sectors.trend: Mixed-to-positive for producers. Oil surged on Saudi pipeline closure and failed OPEC+ suppression. Australia softened gas supply rules, easing Asian fears. Santos preservation flagged as national priority. Diesel costs hitting grain farmers.
sectors.implications: SOL.AX, WDS.AX, BRL.AX benefit from oil spike. Gas policy easing supports gas producers. Downstream (WES.AX, AGL.AX) face input cost pressure. Agribusiness (GRL.AX, TNL.AX) squeezed by diesel.

sectors.trend: Negative. Woolworths breached its own 'Price Freeze' on staples; women's clothing chain closing 177 stores; businesses broadly fearful. Fuel price rise of 30c compounds cost-of-living pressure.
sectors.implications: WOW.AX, WES.AX face margin and traffic risk. Consumer discretionary (SGH.AX, LPX.AX) vulnerable. Defensive staples preferred.

sectors.trend: Negative. No spring bounce in auctions; high-end prices crashing; RBA worried about rental inflation. Leith Van Onselen forecasting further housing falls. Counter-narrative (Jericho) argues collapse warnings are exaggerated.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) pressured by rental inflation and rate sensitivity. Homebuilders (MPL.AX, WBC.AX construction) face demand softness. First-home-buyer surge may provide partial offset.

sectors.trend: Neutral-to-positive. HIVE (HIV.AX) scaling AI cloud via BUZZ HPC. Optus outage (TPG.AX) highlights telco resilience concerns. Flight cancellations (QAN.AX, SYD.AX) from staff shortages.
sectors.implications: AI/tech small-caps gaining attention. Telcos face operational risk. Airlines pressured by staffing and fuel costs.

key_themes: Rate-rise fears and rising bond yields driving broad ASX selloff
Oil supply shock (Saudi pipeline, Iraq drone) lifting energy but pressuring consumers
Iron ore structural weakness hitting ASX heavyweight miners
Housing market bifurcation: high-end crash vs affordable resilience
RBA rental inflation concern complicating rate path
Superannuation policy debate creating political uncertainty
Mining sector liquidity stress via cap-raise wave
AUD weakness on growth scare amplifying import costs

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price spike and fuel cost inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge fuel exposure; favour energy producers (SOL.AX, WDS.AX) over downstream consumers
Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weight; rotate into gold or battery metals (CRB.AX)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate path and rental inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor RBA statements; favour fixed-income and dividend growers over rate-sensitive REITs
Overweight exporters; underweight import-dependent retailers (WOW.AX, SGH.AX)
Avoid high-end REITs; monitor auction clearance rates; watch first-home-buyer data
Avoid small-cap miners with imminent raises; favour cash-flowing majors or battery-tech (CRB.AX)

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy producers on oil supply shock
opportunities.rationale: Saudi pipeline closure and failed price suppression create sustained oil upside; Australian gas policy easing supports domestic gas names

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate into battery metals and critical resources
opportunities.rationale: Critical Resources battery tech passing month-long test; structural demand for lithium/energy metals offsets iron ore weakness

opportunities.recommendation: Selective gold exposure on safe-haven bid
opportunities.rationale: Geopolitical risk (Iraq drone, Trump policy) supports gold despite near-term 'schmould'; Kuniko and Gateway WA exploration upside

defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; Rio Tinto exiting NT; cap-raise wave signals sector stress

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight rate-sensitive REITs and high-end property
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA rental inflation concern, no spring bounce, high-end price crash; prefer affordable-segment or industrial REITs

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness and consumer cost pressure
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD smashed on growth scare; 30c fuel rise and Woolworths price breach squeeze household budgets

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to consolidate lower as oil-driven inflation fears, iron ore weakness, and RBA rate uncertainty persist. AUD weakness and rising bond yields cap risk appetite. Energy names outperform; miners and banks lag. Expect volatility around RBA commentary and oil price action.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Housing correction (high-end) may stabilise within 6-12 months; first-home-buyer surge supports demand. Energy transition (battery metals, gas policy) offers structural upside. Superannuation reform debate could unlock fund-flow tailwinds if resolved constructively. Iron ore recovery depends on China stimulus.
key_catalysts: RBA statement and rental inflation data
Iron ore price floor and China property stimulus
Oil supply resolution (Saudi pipeline, OPEC+ policy)
Superannuation policy decisions (One Nation, early access)
ANZ restructuring progress and bank earnings
AUD/USD trajectory and RBA intervention risk
watch_list: Iron ore spot price (62% Fe) and BHP/RIO guidance
Brent crude and Australian domestic fuel prices
RBA cash rate and rental inflation (CoreLogic/REINZ)
Mining cap-raise volume and dilution impact
US bond yields and Trump fiscal policy (headline 75)
